method: Rule-agnostic Markdown extraction and bounded transport only; no game facts, question IDs, keys or answers.
changes_from_shared_v10: Independent deep heading entries retain their own role/header, complete body and final qualifications.
Numbered ancestor procedures retain their governing steps.
Table rows retain the governing introduction.
One clamped actual text chunk includes its real boundaries/hash, even at EOF.
reader_instructions_policy: Semantic clause matching remains the reader’s responsibility. Generic extraction does not choose a question map or factual answer.
